notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Lilly Looking Through, 10% off!
notes.notes:
Lilly Looking Through, winner of the Intel LevelUp Demo Contest in the categories of Best Adventure / Role-Playing Game and Best Art Design, is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

What Lilly sees is about to change her life forever....

Help our heroine through a variety of enchanting environments brimming with magic and wonder, as she seeks to rewrite the past, change the present, and unlock the ultimate mystery. Geeta Games presents an animated point-and-click adventure for all ages:

Lilly Looking Through.


*Offer ends November 8 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Winners of Intel Level Up Game Demo Contest Released
notes.notes:
The nine category winners of the Intel Level Up Game Demo Contest are now available on Steam.

The winners are:
  • Perfection. - Game Of The Year and Best Puzzle/Physics Game

  • Lilly Looking Through - Best Adventure/Role Playing Game and Best Art Design

  • Assault Android Cactus - Best Action Game

  • Protocell - Best Platformer Game

  • Cube & Star: A Love Story - Best "Other" Game

  • TorqueL - Best Physics

  • BeatBlasters III - Best Sound

  • Life Goes On - Best Character Design

  • FORCED - Best 3D Graphics


Each of these demos, impressed the panel of indie developers and game-industry luminaries assembled by Intel and were selected from more than 90 entries into the contest.

In addition to all nine demos being available to download and play for free, three of the games are available to purchase and play right now, either as fully released or in Steam Early Access.

For more information and to download the free demos, see http://store.steampowered.com/sale/levelup

For contest details, please see: http://www.intel.com/software/levelup2013
